title: Standardized workflow-facing result envelope
description: Every non-plan command result (prepare apply, finish create-draft/plan-publication/publish/closeout) carries this envelope alongside its own command-specific fields, so a thin workflow -- or `release.py render-plan` -- can read the same four fields regardless of which command produced the file. planDigest is the digest of the *source* plan the result was produced from, passed through unchanged; the result itself is not separately digested.

identity.description: The normalized release identity: the exact release version/branch without the CI build revision. Safe to use as a repository-wide concurrency key.
